notes.title: The second installment of the Unalive series has been released.
notes.content:
Unalive is now in 3D graphics with enhanced enemy AI and other improvements. Don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400570/Unalive_010/

notes.title: Fixed some issues
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem with the bosses "crashed into the wall"
[*] Now wooden boxes drop out bullets and  give 75 bullets each boxes
                        "game balance restored"
[*] Segmentation of parasites in bosses battles removed
[*] Materials in UI are put on the plate
[/list]
